originality.rationale: Existing exact rook induced-matching enumeration already implies scalar optimum and state count. The new, compared assertion is connectivity and regularity under exactly two whole-edge replacements, with all one-edge replacements frozen. Inspected matching/graph-product/reconfiguration sources and relevant indexed records did not provide the same implication.
